'''Hylobons''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[Hylobi system]].<ref name="gremmDB" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> [[Aemon Gremm]] and his men, including [[Toht Ra]], were all members of this species. They were part of the [[Hylobon Enforcers]], who served [[Dryden Vos]] as bodyguards in the criminal organization [[Crimson Dawn]].<ref name="The Official Guide" />

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Aemon_Gremm.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Aemon Gremm, a Hylobon]]
Hylobons were a bipedal species possessing two [[limb|arms]] and two legs, with each arm ending in a five-fingered hand. Their faces were wrinkled, with prominent brow ridges and flat faces. They had small, forward-facing eyes with dark irises within their [[eye|eyes]]. The species had thin lips, yellowed teeth with incisors, and two narrow nostril slits instead of a protruding [[nose]]. Their skin was a pale tan color. Hylobons were capable of growing facial hair, including orange beards and mustaches, though facial fur was otherwise sparse outside these areas.<ref name="gremmDB" />

==History==
Hylobons hailed form the [[Hylobi system]], located in the [[Taldot sector]]<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref> of the [[Mid Rim Territories]]<ref name="Timelines">[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]]</ref> The species was present within the wider galaxy by at least 12 BBY<ref name="CC">''[[Crimson Climb]]''</ref>
==Hylobon in galaxy==
Several Hylobons served the [[Crimson Dawn]] [[crime lord]] [[Dryden Vos]] aboard the [[First Light]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Solo" /> as members of Dryden’s [[Hylobon Enforcers]].<ref name="The Official Guide" /> The group was captained by the Hylobon [[Aemon Gremm]].<ref name="gremmDB" /> Another Hylobon, [[Toht Ra]], served as an attendant aboard the First Light, where he confiscated guests’ weapons as they boarded.<ref name="RaDB">{{Databank|toht-ra|Toht Ra}}</ref> Enforcers commonly wore helmets which hid their alien features.<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hylobons were first developed for the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', directed by [[Ron Howard]].<ref name="Solo" /> They were never identified on-screen but were named in the book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', from 2018, written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="The Official Guide" /> In concept art by costume designer [[Glyn Dillon]], Hylobons are depicted with pointed ears positioned toward the back of their heads on each side. Another design by [[Adam Brockbank]] presents them with darker facial skin and a white ring of hair framing their face, shown alongside an early concept for [[Dryden Vos]]. A darker-skinned variant also appears in [[Matthew Savage]]’s three-quarter view of a Hylobon’s face, the design varies with two white stripes running from the face to the back of the head.<ref name="Art of Solo">[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]</ref>
